label: Immanent primary-object route to subsistent self-understanding
summary: Continuation of merged #1855/#1866/#1873. Reuses the existing q.14 a.1 immaterial-to-intellect reading and POTENCY_3 capacity / POTENCY_2 exercise-or-potency route with pure act to derive an actually exercised source intellect. A new immanent-primary-form interpretation distinguishes the form immediately actualizing that intellect, identity with the own subsistent essence, self-directed primary aboutness, and actual intentional apprehension. Conditional Lean theorem obtains source-level IntrinsicSelfKnowledge under an explicit interpretation of grounding by its own form; does not assume WisdomSelfCapacity or TrueSelfApprehensionGrounded. Three finite controls distinguish an impersonal source with genuinely cognitive effects, an actually thinking source whose own form is not self-directed in the model, and a joint positive interpretation. Details, cumulative same-source graph, provisional assessment and revision conditions in docs/notes/causal-perfection-transfer.md#immanent-primary-object-and-subsistent-self-presence-2026-11-23-continuation-of-185518661873.
